summary: Fixed a dashboard data bug: correcting a video's YouTube link with Mark as uploaded kept the old video's view counts for good. Also fixed removed videos in the 7-day upload count and a check-plan crash on malformed plans.
why: Live counters only ever go up (GREATEST), so a wrong link's numbers never left. The data audit (0 errors, 3 warnings) only found three long videos unlisted on YouTube, which is the owner's call, not code.

findings.title: Three long videos unlisted on YouTube
findings.detail: L-20261021-01, L-20261019-02, L-20261018-01: published here, unlisted on YouTube, in two audits running. Owner notification raised.

findings.title: dashboard-data and generator reviewed
findings.detail: API inputs are Zod-checked; one open low item (dsh-006: Overview 7-day sums span 8 days).

changes.title: A corrected YouTube link drops the old link's numbers
changes.detail: markUploaded now resets live counters and daily stats like the Edit path (relinked() in lib/youtube-link.ts, with a test).

changes.title: Overview upload count skips removed videos
changes.detail: Same filter as every other Overview total.

changes.title: check-plan reports a malformed demand or reach reason
changes.detail: reach.check_plan no longer crashes on text views or a string reason; test added.
